failure.description: An identical provider usage replay reused the same measurement identity but generated a new wall-clock timestamp, changing the event hash and triggering the existing measurement identity conflict guard.

repair.description: Remove wall-clock time from the deterministic provider usage event so identical transition, run, receipt, metrics, and lineage produce the same event hash.

ownership.permitted_scope: bounded repository-local repair preserving all validation, authority, custody, mutation, and deployment boundaries
